proof_body:
by
  intro K V _ _ _ f g μ x h hx hfx
  have hgx : g (f x) = x := LinearMap.congr_fun h x
  rw [hfx, map_smul] at hgx
  have hμ : μ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, zero_smul] at hgx
    exact hx hgx.symm
  exact ⟨hμ, ((inv_smul_eq_iff₀ hμ).mpr hgx.symm).symm⟩
target_source: ∀ (K V : Type*) [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] (f g : V →ₗ[K] V) (μ : K) (x : V), g ∘ₗ f = LinearMap.id → x ≠ 0 → f x = μ • x → μ ≠ 0 ∧ g x = μ⁻¹ • x
